supplyOnly.service: Product supply only, self-install or client-arranged

managedProject.service: Full project management, delivery, and installation included

dedicatedPM.service: Dedicated project manager, site visits, CAD layouts, phased delivery

gstRules.statement: Always state ex-GST in quotes. Clarify GST applicability before sending any pricing.

paymentTerms.standard: 30% deposit on order confirmation, 70% on delivery
paymentTerms.neverAccept: Full prepayment before manufacture — creates buyer friction and is non-standard

leadTimes.installerBooking: Installers book 4–6 weeks ahead — communicate this as a service, not pressure
leadTimes.fastTrack: Under 6 weeks only viable with confirmed in-stock items — add logistics premium

contingencyRule: Always add 10–15% contingency to project estimates — protects margin and sets realistic client expectations
quoteFirstAdvantage: Being first quote sets reference price — subsequent quotes are judged against yours. Always aim to be first on the table.
discountPolicy: Never discount without a strategic reason. Discounting without making the value case first destroys the premium positioning.
warrantyProcess: Register all delivered products at handover. 6-year warranty must be actively positioned as a differentiator.
defectProtocol: Respond to defects within 72 hours of discovery. Clients who had issues resolved brilliantly become the strongest referrers.
